title: test(showcase,ui-live): re-point the two nightly live specs to what record page v3 draws
body:
Part of #27114 — the two record-page-v3 reds of nightly run 41009107101 (reading 6516358130). The card stays open until a scheduled `Nightly tiers` run is green.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只改两个夜间 live 测试 spec（`ui/e2e/live/record-history-display.spec.ts`、`examples/app-showcase/e2e/detail-shapes.spec.ts`），让它们按记录页 v3 实际画出的界面去找元素；产品代码零改动。
- 为什么改：夜间 `Nightly tiers` 在 main 上红了两例。一例是 1440 宽下"时间线"开关默认关、事件流折在关闭的「动态」卡片里；另一例是 #27473 把两栏下限改成 760 px 视图后，1200 宽已不再是标签页布局，而且 v3 把主相关列表画成详情页里的表格、不再是独立标签。
- 风险与回滚：只动测试，不影响任何发布包；回滚即 revert 本 PR。风险在于 780 px 这个窗口宽度依赖侧栏图标栏（48 px）和 760 px 下限，日后两者变动时需要重新测量（注释里写了推导）。
- 先看：① `examples/app-showcase/e2e/detail-shapes.spec.ts` 的 Contoso 用例（视口推导注释与新的 v3 断言）；② `ui/e2e/live/record-history-display.spec.ts` 第 2 步（先断言开关关闭、卡片折叠，再点开「动态」卡片）。
- 两分钟验证：在构建好的工作区里运行 `cd examples/app-showcase && OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly pnpm exec vitest run`，预期 `Test Files 2 passed (2)`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Two test files only, each re-pointed at what record page v3 draws, measured under the nightly harness itself. No product change, no retry, no timeout raised, no test renamed, skipped or deleted.

**1. `ui/e2e/live/record-history-display.spec.ts` (driven by `test/console-live-specs.live.test.ts`).** H1 holds. At 1440x900 the nightly harness (a built Console on a fresh database) draws the three-column tier. `showcase_account` is not a worked object: it declares no `stageField`, no lifecycle option `kind` and no `enable.files`. So the reader's Timeline switch defaults to off, and the stream is folded into the closed Activity card at the related column's foot. That card does not mount its blocks until it is opened, so the Changes chip never appeared. The failure snapshot reads `group "Panels"` with `button "Timeline"` (not pressed) and `region "Activity"` with a collapsed `button "Activity"`. The spec now opens that card the way a reader does, and asserts each step:
- the Timeline segment of the Panels control reads `aria-pressed="false"`;
- the card heading's toggle reads `aria-expanded="false"`, is clicked, then reads `"true"`;
- the stream region is scoped inside that card, and every later assertion is unchanged.

I picked opening the card over pressing the Timeline segment. The card is where the stream sits by default, and opening it changes no stored preference. The toggle is named by its heading, because the open stream has an "Activity" filter chip of its own. The first attempt matched both (a strict-mode violation) and was corrected in the second commit. The first assertion carries the 15 s page-open budget the spec already gave its first element.

**2. `examples/app-showcase/e2e/detail-shapes.spec.ts`, Contoso case (driven by `test/showcase-smoke.live.test.ts`).** H2 holds, and there is a second staleness under it.
- *Width.* Measured on this harness with a fresh context and no sidebar cookie: from 768 px (`MOBILE_BREAKPOINT`) to 1000 px the sidebar comes up as its 48 px icon rail. The tier flips between 808 px (two columns) and 800 px (tabs), which is window minus 48 against the 760 px view floor. 1024 px and up have the sidebar expanded, and at 1200 the tier is `two-column` with no tablist. Below 768 px the mobile shell gives the view the whole window, and 760 px drew two columns. So the desktop tabbed tier is a window of 768 to 807 px. The case is pinned at 780x800: 732 px of view, 28 px under the floor and 12 px above the mobile breakpoint. An expanded sidebar only narrows the view further.
- *Prominence.* Even inside the tabbed tier, v3 (objectstack#27055 Target 8) draws `relatedList: 'primary'` lists, Invoices and Projects, as body tables in the Details tab. They are no longer tabs of their own. The strip at 780 px is `Details 5 / Related 3 / Timeline`. The case now asserts:
  - Details is selected and a Related tab exists;
  - there is no Invoices or Projects tab;
  - the Details panel holds the Invoices table (`INV-1002`) and the Projects table (`Data Platform`), their rows read at open;
  - clicking Related selects it and self-fetches Contacts (`Carl Fox`). This replaces the old `waitForTimeout(1500)` plus "panel text is non-empty", which an empty state would also pass.

  The flat-details, money-strip and footer assertions are unchanged.
- *Tier choice.* The case's own header names its invariant: "related-heavy → related lists surface as tabs (prominence rule)". So the case stays in the tabbed tier with a derived viewport, and only its prominence assertions move to v3's rendering. Re-pointing it to the column tier would drop the only live-smoke pin on the tab strip. Every other page in this smoke runs at the Desktop Chrome viewport, which is a column tier. The tab strip is also what the drawer and the split pane draw at every width. The header bullet is updated to say this.

## Acceptance notes

- The 780 px pin is a derived reading of two current values: the 48 px icon rail and the 760 px floor. If the sidebar's auto-collapse range or `RECORD_PAGE_TWO_COLUMN_MIN_WIDTH` moves, this case is where it surfaces, as a missing tablist. The comment carries the derivation so the next re-pin is a re-measure, not a guess.
- `record-history-display` now relies on the reader default (timeline off for a non-worked object). It asserts that default explicitly, so a run against a long-lived local stack whose browser stored the switch as on fails on a named assertion, not on a timeout.
- The beforeAll comment in `detail-shapes.spec.ts` still says Contoso has "2 invoices". The seed has three (INV-1002, INV-1003, INV-1005). It is a comment outside this card's surface, left as is.

## Verification

<details><summary>Local gates: dispatch-gates --commands derived 37 over the 2 paths; all exit 0</summary>

Each gate ran with its exit code captured to disk before any pipe. 35 exited 0 first time. Two were reruns, not reds:
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first exited 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`: 7 packages outside the touched closure had no `dist/`). After building them it exited 0: `113 published require entry point(s) across 70 package(s) load`.
- `pnpm check:query-options-erasure` hit my own 280 s per-gate cap (124). Rerun uncapped, it exited 0: `ratchet holds: 50 unswept non-test site(s) in 15 file(s), none new`.

The reconciliation `dispatch-gates --ran` answered `37 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 37 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 37 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`, exit 0. `check:nul-bytes` exit 0, and the control-byte self-scan of both files found nothing. The families CI runs are read off this PR's check-runs. `dogfood_battery`: n/a, because there is no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm. `skip-changeset`: both files are test specs in packages that publish nothing (`ui/e2e/**`, and the private `@objectstack/example-showcase`).
</details>
